title: Editor Integration & Adapter Layer
description: Wire DocumentEditor to load/save chapter content from filesystem via projectFileService. Create adapter layer resolving currentChapterId → currentConversationId for backward compatibility (L-006). Replace useDraftCache with filesystem persistence.
action: Modify DocumentEditor.tsx to load chapter content from projectFileService on mount, save on update. Create desktop/src/adapters/chapterAdapter.ts mapping chapter → conversation for existing components. Replace useDraftCache usage.

convergence.verification: Editor loads chapter content from filesystem, saves on edit, existing components (StoryBiblePanel etc.) still render via adapter
convergence.definition_of_done: useDraftCache removed from DocumentEditor, chapter content loads from filesystem, save persists to filesystem, backward compat maintained via adapter

files.change: Replace useDraftCache with projectFileService read/write, key on currentChapterId instead of currentConversationId
New adapter mapping currentChapterId to currentConversationId for existing component interfaces

implementation: 1. Create desktop/src/adapters/chapterAdapter.ts: function resolveConversationForChapter(chapterId, chapters, conversations) → maps chapter to its linked conversation ID
2. Modify DocumentEditor.tsx: replace useDraftCache hook with useEffect that calls readChapterContent(projectId, chapterId) on mount
3. Modify handleEditorUpdate: replace persist(text) with writeChapterContent(projectId, chapterId, editor.getJSON())
4. Change component key from currentConversationId to currentChapterId for proper remounting
5. Pass TipTap JSON (not plain text) as initialContent to NikoEditor — fixes formatting loss bug
6. Add debounce for filesystem writes (reuse existing 1500ms pattern)
test: Integration test: load chapter from filesystem, edit content, verify save, switch chapters, verify content preserved
reference: Current DocumentEditor save flow: NikoEditor.onUpdate → handleEditorUpdate → persist(text) via useDraftCache
rationale: Fixes the core persistence bug (formatting lost on reload) and completes the data flow from project store through filesystem to editor
risks: Breaking existing component interfaces — mitigated by adapter layer
Performance of filesystem writes on every keystroke — mitigated by debouncing
